thread.title_full: My Homemade Citrus Floor Cleaner Recipe That Makes My House Smell Like Summer

author: Kateable
title: My Homemade Citrus Floor Cleaner Recipe That Makes My House Smell Like Summer
text:
1 days ago There’s something about summer that makes me want the whole house to feel lighter and fresher.
Open windows.
Fresh flowers.
Clean floors.
And one of my favorite ways to bring that feeling indoors is with a simple homemade floor cleaner that smells bright, clean, and a little bit like sunshine.
I started making this cleaner a few years ago, and now I look forward to using it every week.
Photo by Kate Tekurio Why I Started Making My Own Floor Cleaner I wanted something simple that would leave my floors clean without a strong chemical smell.
Most store-bought cleaners worked fine, but I found myself wishing for something that smelled more like summer and less like a cleaning aisle.
After a little experimenting, I found a combination that I absolutely love.
My Favorite Summer Floor Cleaner Recipe Ingredients 1 gallon warm water ½ cup white vinegar 1 tablespoon Sal Suds 10 drops sweet orange essential oil 10 drops lemon essential oil 5 drops lavender essential oil Directions Fill a bucket with warm water. Add the vinegar and Sal Suds. Stir gently. Add the essential oils. Mop floors as usual. That's it.
Simple and refreshing.
Why I Love This Blend Sweet Orange Sweet orange gives the cleaner a cheerful, sunny scent that instantly reminds me of summer.
Lemon Lemon adds that unmistakable fresh-clean aroma that makes the whole house feel brighter.
Lavender Lavender softens the citrus and adds a subtle calming note.
Together, they make cleaning feel surprisingly enjoyable.
Where I Use It This cleaner works beautifully on:
Tile floors Laminate flooring Vinyl floors Sealed hardwood floors (always follow manufacturer recommendations) And because the scent is so light, the house smells fresh without feeling overpowering.
Other Summer Blends I Love Citrus Mint Blend 10 drops lemon 10 drops sweet orange 5 drops spearmint Garden Herb Blend 10 drops lemon 10 drops rosemary 10 drops lavender Grapefruit Sunshine Blend 15 drops grapefruit 10 drops sweet orange Each blend gives the house a slightly different mood, but they all make me think of summer.
Why I Keep Making It Cleaning floors isn't exactly my favorite task.
But having a cleaner that smells this good makes it a little more enjoyable.
And every time I finish mopping and catch that fresh citrus scent drifting through the house, I'm reminded that sometimes the little things—like a clean floor and open windows—are what make a home feel welcoming.
That's why this homemade floor cleaner has become part of my weekly routine and one of my favorite ways to bring the scent of summer indoors.
